entries.title: Romans 1:1
segments: Paul, a servant of Jesus Christ, a called apostle, separated to the gospel of God

entries.title: Romans 1:2
segments: (which He had promised beforehand through His prophets in the Holy Scriptures),

entries.title: Romans 1:3
segments: about His Son, Jesus Christ our Lord, who was made of the seed of David according to the flesh,

entries.title: Romans 1:4
segments: who was marked out the Son of God in power, according to [the] Spirit of holiness, by the resurrection from [the] dead;

entries.title: Romans 1:5
segments: by whom we have received grace and apostleship, to obedience to the faith among all nations, for His name;

entries.title: Romans 1:6
segments: among whom you also are the called-out ones of Jesus Christ:

entries.title: Romans 1:7
segments: to all those who are in Rome, beloved of God, called-out saints. Grace to you and peace from God our Father and [the] Lord Jesus Christ.

entries.title: Romans 1:8
segments: First, I thank my God through Jesus Christ for you all, that your faith is spoken of throughout the whole world.

entries.title: Romans 1:9
segments: For God is my witness, whom I serve with my spirit in the gospel of His Son, that without ceasing I make mention of you

entries.title: Romans 1:10
segments: always in my prayers, making request if by any means now at length I might have a prosperous journey by the will of God to come to you.

entries.title: Romans 1:11
segments: For I long to see you, so that I may impart to you some spiritual gift, to you for the establishing of you.

entries.title: Romans 1:12
segments: And this is to be comforted together with you by our mutual faith, both yours and mine.

entries.title: Romans 1:13
segments: But I would not have you ignorant, brothers, that oftentimes I purposed to come to you, and was kept back until the present; that I might have some fruit among you also, even as among other nations.

entries.title: Romans 1:14
segments: I am debtor both to the Greeks and to the foreigners, both to the wise and to the unwise.

entries.title: Romans 1:15
segments: So, as much as is in me [lies], I am ready to preach the gospel to you who are at Rome also.

entries.title: Romans 1:16
segments: For I am not ashamed of the gospel of Christ, for it is [the] power of God unto salvation to everyone who believes, to the Jew first and also to the Greek.

entries.title: Romans 1:17
segments: For in it the righteousness of God is revealed from faith to faith, as it is written, "The just shall live by faith."

entries.title: Romans 1:18
segments: For the wrath of God is revealed from Heaven against all ungodliness and unrighteousness of men, who hold the truth in unrighteousness,

entries.title: Romans 1:19
segments: because the thing which may be known of God is clearly revealed within them, for God revealed [it] to them.

entries.title: Romans 1:20
segments: For the unseen things of Him from [the] creation of [the] world [are] clearly seen, being realized by the things that are made, [even] His eternal power and Godhead, for them to be without excuse.

entries.title: Romans 1:21
segments: Because, knowing God, they did not glorify Him as God, neither were thankful. But [they] became vain in their imaginations, and their foolish heart was darkened.

entries.title: Romans 1:22
segments: Professing to be wise, they became fools

entries.title: Romans 1:23
segments: and changed the glory of the incorruptible God into an image made like corruptible man, and birds, and four-footed animals, and creeping things.

entries.title: Romans 1:24
segments: Therefore God also gave them up to uncleanness through the lusts of [their] hearts, to dishonor their own bodies between themselves.

entries.title: Romans 1:25
segments: For they changed the truth of God into a lie, and they worshiped and served the created thing more than the Creator, who is blessed forever. Amen.

entries.title: Romans 1:26
segments: For this cause, God gave them up to dishonorable affections. For even their women changed the natural use into that which is against nature.

entries.title: Romans 1:27
segments: And likewise also the men, leaving the natural use of the woman, burned in their lust toward one another; males with males working out shamefulness, and receiving in themselves the recompense which was fitting for their error.

entries.title: Romans 1:28
segments: And even as they did not think fit to have God in [their] knowledge, God gave them over to a reprobate mind, to do the things not right,

entries.title: Romans 1:29
segments: being filled with all unrighteousness, fornication, wickedness, covetousness, maliciousness; [being] full of envy, murder, quarrels, deceit, evil habits, [becoming] whisperers,

entries.title: Romans 1:30
segments: backbiters, haters of God, insolent, proud, braggarts, inventors of evil things, disobedient to parents,

entries.title: Romans 1:31
segments: without discernment, covenant-breakers, without natural affection, unforgiving, unmerciful;

entries.title: Romans 1:32
segments: who, knowing the righteous order of God, that those practicing such things are worthy of death, not only do them, but have pleasure in those practicing [them].
